steps.en: Clone the repo and install its requirements
Go into one architecture's folder and run its single script
steps.zh: 进入某个架构的目录，运行它唯一的脚本

steps.en: Downloads the toy dataset (MNIST for DCGAN) into data/
steps.zh: 把玩具数据集（DCGAN 用 MNIST）下载到 data/

steps.en: Trains generator and discriminator against each other, one Adam step each per batch
steps.zh: 让生成器和判别器对抗训练，每批各走一步 Adam

steps.en: Saves a grid of generated samples to images/ every few hundred batches
steps.zh: 每隔几百批把一格格生成样本存进 images/

steps.en: Read the script top to bottom beside the samples; change a layer or loss and rerun
steps.zh: 对照样本把脚本从头读到尾，改一层或一个损失再跑

value.en: You see a GAN paper's core idea as one readable, runnable file instead of a framework
value.zh: 一篇 GAN 论文的核心思路变成一个能读、能跑的文件，而不是一套框架

sources: https://github.com/eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN/blob/master/implementations/dcgan/dcgan.py (datasets.MNIST into ../../data/mnist, Adam optimizer_G / optimizer_D per batch, save_image to images/ every sample_interval=400 batches)
